newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - April 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- European countries suggest to Washington to move to revive the Middle East peace process.
- Saudi Real Estate Company SRECO posted $16 million net profit in 1996.
- Yemen asked for a $100 million loan from the Arab Monetary Fund.
- Saudi Arabia's Arab Investment Co posted $13 million net profit in the first quarter of 1997.
- Syria and Jordan are to open a new border post between the two states on April 27.
- Kuwait to probe $2.5 billion of foreign investments loss in Kuwaiti Petroleum Corporation.
- New United Arab Emirates government approved the 1997 budget of 19.8 billion dirhams.
